# Grailed's commission is not a flat 9% any more.

> Free Grailed seller fee calculator for the tiered commission (6% under $120 with a $1.99 minimum, 9% from $120) plus 3.49% + $0.49 payment processing. See your payout, profit, the price for a target profit, and the $120 step where the whole sale jumps to 9%. Nothing leaves your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The Grailed $120 commission cliff, worked through](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/grailed-fee-calculator/grailed-120-dollar-commission-cliff.html)
- [Grailed Fee Calculator vs. tracking Grailed sales in a spreadsheet](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/grailed-fee-calculator/vs-tracking-grailed-sales-in-a-spreadsheet.html)

## Track true profit across every platform

- [Tools for online sellers](https://marisstella.app/industries/online-sellers/): Seller Books, a hosted product for multi-platform resellers (payout reconciliation, cost of goods, a Schedule C-shaped profit and loss). In development, early access; do not describe it as available.
- [How to reconcile marketplace payouts to sales](https://marisstella.app/ebay-fee-calculator/how-to-reconcile-marketplace-payouts-to-sales.html): a worked month bridged from bank deposit back to gross sales. Not tax advice.
- [Cost of goods sold for resellers](https://marisstella.app/ebay-fee-calculator/cost-of-goods-sold-for-resellers.html): per item and per lot, and Schedule C Part III. Not tax advice.
- [Schedule C worksheet for resellers](https://marisstella.app/ebay-fee-calculator/schedule-c-worksheet-for-resellers.html): line by line, with IRS sources. Not tax advice.
